advices.diagnosis: The class has a low cohesion score (LCOM4 = 2) because its methods operate on unrelated data: it formats a title, delegates to a repository, sends email, and formats a Customer object (feature envy). The class references two internal collaborators (DCC = 2) and all its attributes are private (DAM = 1.0), which is fine. The main design problem is the mixed responsibilities that cause the cohesion warning.

suggestions.title: Extract customer formatting into its own presenter

advices.risk_notes: The refactor adds a small amount of indirection and a new class, which could increase the overall DCC count for the new class but leaves `ReportView`'s DCC unchanged. Ensure that dependency injection is wired correctly in the application container; otherwise, runtime errors may occur.
